jei.focal_decay.note.copy_model: Trainable model + blank model -> 2 copies (the original is not consumed). Each generation loses radius, and copying stops at the cap.
jei.focal_decay.note.feed_fragment: Candidate Observer + any semantic fragment -> progress increases and the fragment is consumed. The fastest way for a candidate to learn.
jei.focal_decay.derive.semantic_lock: Pick "Train: Semantic Lock" in the Training Terminal, right-click blocks/creatures to record targets, then return and choose "Finish Training"
jei.focal_decay.derive.guided: Pick "Train: Guided Mutation", right-click to record targets from one concept, then return, finish training and resolve concept q
jei.focal_decay.derive.bio: No training needed; craft it straight from the prototype (see the recipe page)
jei.focal_decay.derive.total_activated: Carry the inactive OBSR-EX to the End Throne and complete the enthronement ritual
jei.focal_decay.derive.candidate: Crafted as a candidate body; right-click blocks/creatures to build progress, or combine with semantic fragments to inject knowledge
jei.focal_decay.info.prototype: OBSR Prototype: an untrained blank classifier with no function of its own, only a writable record table. Place it in the Training Terminal and pick a direction to begin.
jei.focal_decay.info.total_inactive: Inactive OBSR-EX: its parameters are hard-wired, and only the enthronement ritual at the End Throne can load them.
jei.focal_decay.info.bio: Bio Stabiliser Model: no training needed. It trades the health of nearby creatures for its stabilising effect, and stops protecting once its energy runs out.
jei.focal_decay.info.anchor: Observer Anchor: insert an OBSR model into the slot to stabilise the surrounding area. With no model inserted it has no effect at all.
jei.focal_decay.info.terminal: Training Terminal: place an OBSR prototype in it to choose a training direction, take the prototype back out to record targets, then return to finish training.
